brief_verbatim: lets make an ad with mokobara. i would preferably give it the odysey movie angel. the proatagonist had mokbara bags. the protagonist found his mokobara bag, while he was on the island where he was kept for years. in that bag he founds her wives photo and a lot of stuff that he could use to go back. he packs food and stuff and goes back. would be funny that he could keep his arms in the bag and food and so much stuff. Avoid getting copyright violoations from odysssey.

objective.viewer_should: smile at the reveal and remember that a Mokobara carries a lot and comes home

distinctive_assets.name: Transit Backpack 30L, colourway Private Island
must_be_exact: no lettering or logo on the generated bag

distinctive_assets.name: mokobara wordmark
must_be_exact: the site's own SVG, lowercase, composed by code

mandatory.realisation: the bag is a generated likeness of one real product, anchored on the fetched product photos

verification.method: bag likeness vs source/mokobara/…Private_Island_1.jpg on keyframes; DET: reference sha256 on every attempt

mandatory.customer_words: found his mokobara bag, while he was on the island where he was kept for years
mandatory.realisation: beat 2 discovery on the island; the man visibly bears years

mandatory.customer_words: in that bag he founds her wives photo
mandatory.realisation: beat 3: a photograph of a woman taken from the bag

verification.method: keyframe of beat 3; no identifiable real person

mandatory.customer_words: a lot of stuff that he could use to go back … he packs food and stuff and goes back
mandatory.realisation: beats 4–6: useful things out of / into the bag; he leaves by sea with the bag

verification.method: keyframes of beats 4–6; DET: beat list covers find → pack → leave

mandatory.customer_words: would be funny that he could keep his arms in the bag and food and so much stuff
mandatory.realisation: the comic reveal: arm to the shoulder, both arms, things keep coming out

verification.method: 'does the gag read?' on the beat-4 clip — riskiest, micro-qualified first

mandatory.customer_words: the odysey movie angel + Avoid getting copyright violoations
mandatory.realisation: Odyssey-shaped story only; no names, titles, actors, footage, score, artwork or a specific film's look

verification.method: prompt guard word list (Stage 2 ip_rules); LJ: 'does any frame resemble a specific film?'

mandatory.customer_words: lets make an ad with mokobara
mandatory.realisation: brand early (the bag) and a brand close composed by code

verification.method: end-card strings byte-exact vs copy deck; wordmark = hashed SVG; frame text scan

forbidden.item: any claim not on the product page (indestructible, waterproof, lifetime, TSA, warranty, scarcity, ranking, price framing)
odyssey / odysseus / penelope / ithaca / calypso / homer / nolan / cast away / wilson / hanks and the rest of the guard list
forbidden.source: customer: 'Avoid getting copyright violations'; Stage 2 ip_rules.guard_words

tone.register: cinematic survival, dry comic turn at the reveal, ending on the brand
tone.example_accepted: the brand's own line: 'Out doing what it does best.' (site copy, dry, not exclamatory)

acceptance.statement: the bag on screen is recognisably the Transit Backpack (navy, yellow lining) in every beat it appears
the gag reads: arms disappear into the bag further than a bag allows and things keep coming out
the story reads find → photo → pack → leave without narration
no name, title, actor or artwork from any specific film; nothing on the guard list in prompts or frames
wordmark, product line, tagline and CTA are byte-exact and legible on a phone; 30 s; 1080×1920; loudness in target

decisions.choice: 9:16, 1080×1920, one file for Reels/Facebook/Shorts; no 16:9 first pass
decisions.why: dossier: Meta Pixel + Google Ads tag = paid vertical; YouTube channel near-empty
decisions.cost_if_wrong: a 16:9 re-composition, ≈ USD 0 if the stills survive the crop; else re-draws

decisions.why: no duration in the brief; seven beats and a brand close; spec exists from RentOK
decisions.cost_if_wrong: trim to 15 s is an edit, ≈ USD 0

decisions.why: brand copy is plain English; no speech keeps the job out of manual-only lip-sync cells and voice-by-ear review
decisions.cost_if_wrong: weaker brand recall (sk_abcd_0012); adding a spoken line later is a new asset

decisions.choice: hero product = Transit Backpack 30L, Private Island
decisions.why: 35 public photos; worn on the back it reads on a castaway walking, packing, pushing off
decisions.cost_if_wrong: every still re-drawn ≈ USD 0.5 + clips ≈ USD 2.2

decisions.choice: tone: cinematic survival, dry comic turn, brand close
decisions.why: the brief's own arc; the brand's register is dry
decisions.cost_if_wrong: a re-take of one beat ≈ USD 0.4–0.8

decisions.choice: no price on the end card
decisions.why: brand story, not an offer; compare-at framing unknown
decisions.cost_if_wrong: adding a price line is a code change, USD 0

asks.question: Backpack or Cabin Luggage as the hero product?
